name: Termux Repositories
description: Mirror selection and large-package handling for Termux's pkg/apt repositories.
instructions:
1. The default Termux mirror (https://packages.termux.dev) is often slow or blocked on networks in China, parts of India, behind corporate firewalls, and on some ISPs. Symptom: `pkg install` hangs at "0% [Connecting to packages.termux.dev]" or fails with "Could not resolve host" / "NO_PUBKEY" / repeated 404s.
2. To switch mirrors interactively, the user must run `termux-change-repo` INSIDE Termux (it opens a TUI picker). Gotcha cannot drive that TUI from run_termux_command. Tell the user to open Termux, run the command, pick a mirror, and not return to chat until done.
3. To switch non-interactively from a script, overwrite TWO files:
   - `$PREFIX/etc/apt/sources.list` with: `deb <mirror> termux-main`
   - `$PREFIX/etc/apt/sources.list.d/root.list` with: `deb <mirror> termux-root`
   Then run `apt-get update -y`. `<PREFIX>` is `/data/data/com.termux/files/usr`.
4. Known mirrors (substitute the user's geography):
   - Official primary: https://packages.termux.dev/apt/termux-main
   - Official secondary: https://termux.mentality.org/apt/termux-main
   - Tsinghua (China): https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/termux/apt/termux-main
   - USTC (China): https://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/termux/apt/termux-main
   - ISCAS (China): https://mirror.iscas.ac.cn/termux/apt/termux-main
   - CERN (China): https://mirrors.cernet.edu.cn/termux/apt/termux-main
   - NJU (China): https://mirror.nju.edu.cn/termux/apt/termux-main
   - Netherlands: https://ftp.snt.utwente.nl/termux/apt/termux-main
5. After a mirror change, ALWAYS run `pkg update -y` to verify the new server. A `NO_PUBKEY` error means the mirror is missing the signing key — fall back to the official primary.
6. Large packages — ffmpeg, python, rust, chromium, golang, nodejs-lts, texlive, qt — typically take 5-15 minutes to install even on a fast mirror. Always raise timeout_seconds to 600 and warn the user before kicking one off.
7. If `pkg install` keeps failing midway, split the network step from the install step: `pkg download <pkg>` puts the .deb in $PREFIX/var/cache/apt/archives/; then `cd $PREFIX/var/cache/apt/archives && dpkg -i *.deb` installs from local cache. This is also useful for retrying a single bad package.
8. For reproducible installs across mirrors, prefer `pkg install -y` over `apt install`; `pkg` is the wrapper that handles Termux-specific package names and dependencies and is the supported interface.
